{{Quote|Legends say that this track retraces the route used by local smuggler, Trein Veltin as he tried to elude authorities intent on his arrest. Weaving through the streets desperately trying to lose his pursuers he made it out of the city. Unfortunately his escape was cut short due to a fatal collision with a flesh eating chuba. Since that time many have made the run in his memory. Eventually it became a semi-formal track for a thoroughly illegal street race.|The [[Narmle Memorial Rally]] race coordinator, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:NMR">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other|Swoop race track: "Narmle Memorial Rally" on Rori}}</ref>}}
'''Trein Veltin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] on the [[Naboo/Legends|Nabooian]] moon [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. According to legends, Veltin tried to escape authorities intent on his arrest on his [[Swoop/Legends|swoop bike]] by weaving through the narrow streets of the city of [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]]. He made it out of the city but his escape was cut short due to a fatal collision with a flesh eating [[Gorg/Legends|chuba]].<ref name="SWG:NMR" />

Since this incident, many swoop racers have made the run in his memory. His escape route eventually became a semi-formal track for a thoroughly illegal street race, called the [[Narmle Memorial Rally]].<ref name="SWG:NMR" />
